output.reason: [ev-89034c5d2c74] says DSR service connections that "were established prior to Cilium v1.13.3" will be disrupted. It ties exposure to when a connection was established, not to the version the environment upgrades from. A long-lived connection set up under a pre-1.13.3 agent could still be alive after later upgrades, so the edge-from-version <1.13.3 conjunct is narrower than the text and would miss exposed environments. Whether such connections still exist is runtime state that no configuration shows, so the only supportable exposure is the runtime undecidable leaf on its own.

correction.statement: Service connections that use Direct-Server-Return and were established while a Cilium version older than v1.13.3 was running will be disrupted on upgrade to v1.16.0 and must be re-established. Exposure depends on whether such live connections still exist, which is runtime state.

exposure.needed: whether the environment still has live Direct-Server-Return service connections that were established while a Cilium version older than v1.13.3 was running
